drm/vkms: Fix use after free and double free on init error
[ Upstream commit ed15511a773df86205bda66c37193569575ae828 ]

If the driver initialization fails, the vkms_exit() function might
access an uninitialized or freed default_config pointer and it might
double free it.

Fix both possible errors by initializing default_config only when the
driver initialization succeeded.

Reported-by: Louis Chauvet <[email]>
Closes: https://lore.kernel.org/all/Z5uDHcCmAwiTsGte@louis-chauvet-laptop/
Fixes: 2df7af93fdad ("drm/vkms: Add vkms_config type")
Signed-off-by: José Expósito <[email]>
Reviewed-by: Thomas Zimmermann <[email]>
Reviewed-by: Louis Chauvet <[email]>
Link: https://patchwork.freedesktop.org/patch/msgid/[email]
Signed-off-by: Louis Chauvet <[email]>
Signed-off-by: Sasha Levin <[email]>

-	if (ret)

 		kfree(config);
+		return ret;

-	return ret;

+

 }

@@ -277,9 +279,10 @@ static void vkms_destroy(struct vkms_config *config)

 {

+	if (!default_config)
+		return;
 
+	vkms_destroy(default_config);
